# Content Structure

## Tool Detail Page Structure
- Tool basic info (name, vendor, pricing, rating, category)
- Key features (12+ features per tool)
- Pros and cons analysis
- Use cases and applications
- Comparison with competitors
- Pricing plans and tiers
- FAQ section (auto-generated)
- Related tools and articles
- Screenshots and interface previews

## Article / Review Page Structure
- Executive summary with verdict
- Hands-on testing experience
- Detailed feature analysis
- Performance data and benchmarks
- Pros and cons
- Pricing comparison
- Comparison with alternatives
- FAQ section
- Final verdict and recommendation
- Affiliate disclosure

## Alternative Guide Page Structure
- Quick comparison table (rank, tool, rating, best for, price)
- Detailed review of each alternative (10+ tools)
- Feature comparison table (target tool vs best alternative)
- FAQ section (5+ common questions)
- Buying guide and recommendations
- Related tools and articles

# Review Methodology
- All tools are tested hands-on by the editorial team
- Six-dimension scoring system: Features, Ease of Use, Performance, Value for Money, Support, Innovation
- Ratings are updated regularly based on new features and testing
- Reviews include real screenshots and usage data
- Affiliate relationships do not influence ratings or rankings
- Full methodology: https://www.aitoolcrux.com/methodology

# Data Sources
- Official website information and documentation
- Hands-on testing and usage experience
- Performance benchmarks and comparison tests
- User reviews and community feedback
- Pricing and feature verification

# Update Frequency
- Tool information: Weekly updates
- Review articles: Daily updates
- Rankings: Monthly updates
- Comparison data: Real-time verification
- Alternative guides: Bi-weekly updates
